subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers repair this contributor branch as the canonical Google Chat media fallback, or pause it in favor of another refreshed implementation?
rationale: Two open candidate PRs target the same Google Chat fallback, this branch is conflicting, and source-level proof does not settle the live delivery or security-boundary risks without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair This Branch Before Merge
options.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the detector, preserve action metadata, and require inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Select Another Canonical PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers choose another open implementation that becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers action, adapter, and monitor paths.

options.title: Accept Source Proof Deliberately
options.body: Maintainers may waive live proof after code repair, but the waiver should be explicit because Google Chat delivery remains unproven in an inspectable real setup.

recommendation.title: Repair This Branch Before Merge
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the detector, preserve action metadata, and require inspectable app-auth proof before final review.
